headword: {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}

definitions.explanation: The direction directly contrary to the one in question. Everyday vocabulary for giving directions, describing traffic and train travel, and talking about movement in general.

examples.japanese: {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I got on a train going the opposite direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{反対方向|はんたいほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The wind shifted to the opposite direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反対方向|はんたいほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{十分|じゅっぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧しまった。
examples.english: I took the wrong road and walked a full ten minutes in the opposite direction from the station.

notes:
⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ (opposite, reverse) + ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ (direction). The thing being reversed is marked with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反対方向|はんたいほうこう} (the opposite direction from the station).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to go in the opposite direction
- {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧: to turn the other way
- {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: a train going the other way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}→逆方向：15966_gyakuhoukou⟧: reverse direction — nearly interchangeable, slightly more technical
- ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧: the reverse, the opposite — a noun on its own, used far more broadly than for physical direction
